mapper.select: SELECT ROLE_CODE , ROLE_NAME , ROLE_DESC FROM ROLE_MST WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} ORDER BY ROLE_CODE

WITH RECURSIVE MENU_TREE AS ( SELECT M.MENU_ID , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_DESC , M.PARENT_MENU_ID , M.MENU_LEVEL , M.SORT_NO , M.SYSTEM_TYPE , LPAD(M.SORT_NO::VARCHAR, 10, '0') || '/' || M.MENU_ID AS SORT_PATH FROM MENU M WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(M.PARENT_MENU_ID), '') IS NULL AND M.USING_YN = 'Y'
UNION ALL
SELECT C.MENU_ID , C.MENU_NAME , C.MENU_DESC , C.PARENT_MENU_ID , C.MENU_LEVEL , C.SORT_NO , C.SYSTEM_TYPE , P.SORT_PATH || '/' || LPAD(C.SORT_NO::VARCHAR, 10, '0') || '/' || C.MENU_ID FROM MENU C INNER JOIN MENU_TREE P ON C.PARENT_MENU_ID = P.MENU_ID WHERE C.USING_YN = 'Y' ) SELECT M.MENU_ID , M.MENU_NAME , M.MENU_DESC , M.PARENT_MENU_ID , M.MENU_LEVEL , M.SYSTEM_TYPE , CASE WHEN R.MENU_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS ASSIGNED_YN , COALESCE(R.REG_AUTH, 'N') AS REG_AUTH , COALESCE(R.UPD_AUTH, 'N') AS UPD_AUTH , COALESCE(R.DEL_AUTH, 'N') AS DEL_AUTH , COALESCE(R.EXC_AUTH, 'N') AS EXC_AUTH , COALESCE(R.FLE_AUTH, 'N') AS FLE_AUTH FROM MENU_TREE M LEFT JOIN ROLE_MENU R ON R.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID AND R.ROLE_CODE = #{role_code} AND R.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} WHERE 1 = 1
AND M.SYSTEM_TYPE = #{system_type}
ORDER BY M.SORT_PATH
